name: Куряче філе сире
source: Generic raw single-ingredient meat reference; Ukrainian retail identity cross-check
audit_note: Single-ingredient raw chicken breast contains no meaningful carbohydrate. Brand/package duplicates are unnecessary. Marinades/breading are separate recipe-dependent identities.

name: Свинина сира
audit_note: CarbCalc identity is intentionally broad because carbohydrate is 0 g for plain raw pork. Fat/protein vary substantially by cut, so this entry is for carbohydrate counting, not precise cut-specific energy estimation.

name: Яловичина сира
audit_note: Plain raw beef is a zero-carbohydrate generic identity. Cut-specific protein/fat differences do not justify multiple CarbCalc carbohydrate identities.

name: Філе індички сире
source: Generic raw single-ingredient meat reference; Ukrainian retail identity cross-check
audit_note: Plain turkey breast is represented generically at 0 g carbohydrate. Processed turkey products, marinades and breaded products are not covered by this identity.
